# Update Conversation - CCE

Source: https://help.webexconnect.io/docs/cce-update-conversation-engage-node
Documentation version: 6.20.0
Retrieved: 2026-09-08T23:29:24+00:00

This node calls Webex Engage Update Conversation API to update the conversation on Webex Engage. While configuring flows in Webex Connect, you’d need to use this node for updating the conversation.

## Authorization

Refer to section [Node Authorizations](https://help.imiconnect.io/docs/wxcc-node-palette#section-node-authorization) for more information.
